clean_random_details.tooltip: Drop the app's random toys/decor that clash with a custom design.

variation.tooltip: The seed of whatever is left random (brand, toys, decor): the same number always builds the same prompt, even after a reload or restart; change it to re-roll.

accessories.tooltip: One per line; empty = random, as in the app.

extra_prompt.tooltip: Free text added before the Avoid list.

strip_regex.tooltip: One regular expression per line (spaces count). Whatever it matches is cut from the app's prompt, like `stripRegex` of a spec card: use it to drop the app's own focal-furniture / lived-in sentences that contradict the card.

wall_architecture.tooltip: full-wall = the mural covers the whole wall (a mural listing). The app rolls scallop-trim (wallpaper only on the lower two thirds under a scalloped moulding) in 35% of the builds for every ratio except 9:16; random = like the app.

prompt_mode.tooltip: full = the web app's long prompt (written for generating a room from nothing, about 6 000 characters). brief = a short structured prompt for a reference image (about 1 200 characters): what the photo is, the two references by number, the scene, light and camera. brief uses the style and the colour you pick here (their words come from Promt/trends.json, the same file the web app reads), brief_subject / brief_scene / brief_framing, lighting, camera_body, lens, aperture and with_texture, and ignores the rest. Aspect ratio, size and quality are fields of the request, never part of the text.

brief_subject.tooltip: brief: what the room is, e.g. 'a calm Japandi nursery for a baby under 2 years'.

brief_scene.tooltip: brief: what is in the room, described positively (the only things in it, sizes, palette).

brief_framing.tooltip: brief: where the camera stands and what the frame shows (corners, ceiling line, floor).

brief_product.tooltip: brief: what image 1 is, e.g. 'the wall mural' (from the listing's spec, key brief).

brief_product_short.tooltip: brief: the short name of the product, e.g. 'the mural' (used in 'even on the mural').

brief_wall_rule.tooltip: brief: how the product sits on the wall, e.g. 'It covers the whole feature wall edge to edge, floor to ceiling...'. A fact of the listing: a scalloped-trim wallpaper covers only the lower two thirds.

brief_people.tooltip: brief: none = the room is empty of people; from_behind = a person is allowed, strictly from behind or in a half-turn from behind, never a face (owner rule).

brief_anchor.tooltip: brief: add one sentence that tells the model to reproduce image 1 (the mural) unchanged on the wall.

with_texture.tooltip: brief: mention image 2 (the paper texture). Switch off when the KIE node does not send the texture.

camera_body.tooltip: random = picked by the app each build

lens.tooltip: a wide 28mm suits a spacious room; random = picked by the app each build

aperture.tooltip: higher f = more of the room sharp

depth_of_field.tooltip: deep keeps the whole mural sharp
